selection: All 16 frozen 3150 MHz R11 source and other-target scans; first following S and R within 1800 s of last scan plus nearest earlier/later S/R/S cadences by archive metadata. No intensity-based selection.

barycentric.formula: f_top=f_bary*(1+v_corr/c), optical convention; restrictive constant-frequency model

claims: A related OFF track or reverse-control pattern raises interference concern, does not prove common origin. No independent confirmation or extraterrestrial discovery.
